title: storage: Remove unused nolint directive
body:
golangci-lint v2.13.2 no longer reports SA1019 for the deprecated `lockfile.Locker` alias, so the `//nolint:staticcheck` directive on it is now flagged as unused by `nolintlint`.

Split out of the OCI Referrers API work, where it was riding along unrelated.

comments.body: Closing: the premise was wrong. CI shows staticcheck still reports `SA1019` for `lockfile.Locker` at golangci-lint v2.13.2, so the `//nolint:staticcheck` directive is doing its job and removing it breaks `validate / lint`. Nothing to split out after all.

Yes, that’s some kind of caching flake that shows up from time to time. Figuring out the actual cause would be appreciated.

(A reminder: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/community/blob/main/LLM_POLICY.md )
